hook_patterns: A provocative, ancient proverb stated as an absolute law of human nature.

ideas: Arthur Schopenhauer's rule on why intelligent minds crave solitude, featuring framed typographic animations of 'Essays and Aphorisms'.

avoid: Generic quote walls with low-effort AI text-to-speech and unedited hashtags as the title.
Overused 'Sigma male' audio clips paired with unrelated modern pop-culture clips.
